What did you eat yesterday?] Speaker B: I eat pizza. Speaker A: पिज़्ज़ा! और बात कल की हो रही है तो eat नहीं ate होगा। I ate pizza. ट्रेन कहाँ से पकड़ते हो? [Pizza! And since we are talking about yesterday, it won't be eat, it will be ate. I ate pizza. Where do you catch the train from?] Speaker B: I pick train from railway station.
